WHIM Hub

Warehouse Inventory Manager · Central workspace for the existing inventory workflows

Choose a workflow to open its live working screen. All workflows read and write the same inventory state; this hub does not create a second copy of inventory data.

Ready. WHIM Hub uses the existing shared inventory data in this browser profile.

Backup / Data（备份 / 数据）

The preloaded spreadsheet records are sample/test data for demonstration and working-proof purposes. Material additions, edits, deletions, and warehouse movements are saved in this browser. Deleting spreadsheet data permanently clears all current materials and warehouse movements from this browser. Export a backup first if you may need the data later.

WHIM Version v2

Company Identity（公司信息设置）

Change the company name and logo shown in the heading. Settings are saved in this browser; use Update Package Folder Logo to replace the logo file inside the app package.

Logo preview（标志预览）

After saving the new logo above, choose the app's winapp folder when prompted. This replaces gst-logo.jpg in that folder so the packaged app uses the updated logo. If folder access is unavailable, a replacement logo file will be downloaded for you to copy into that folder.

⚙ Settings（设置）

Customize the appearance and restore inventory data from an Excel workbook. Changes are saved on this device.

⇧ Upload Excel Backup（上传 Excel 备份）

Material Information（物料信息）

Multi-Image Material Scanner（多图片物料扫描器）

Select multiple label images. Each image is processed as a separate material. OCR results are suggestions; verify every field before applying or saving.

Choose one or more images to begin OCR identification.

Existing style-and-color combinations automatically use their existing item codes. New combinations require a new item code before they can be applied. OCR requires the Tesseract engine to load; an internet connection may be needed on first use.

Email Inbound / Outbound Summary（发送出入库汇总）

Select the movement type, choose the exact records, and export a matching Excel workbook. Only records shown and checked below are included.

For safety and compatibility, the workbook is downloaded first. Most browsers do not allow a web page to attach files automatically, so attach the downloaded .xlsx in the email compose window before sending.
